description:
**Career Area:**


Engineering**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**What You Will Do:**

* **Drive change management** that helps teams adopt new technologies, processes, and ways of working while sustaining engagement and delivery.
* Collaborate with global product, architecture, quality, and engineering stakeholders to achieve customer and business objectives.

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
* **Managing People:** Relentlessly committed to building, coaching, and developing high\-performing teams.

* **Change Leadership:** Ability to influence adoption of new tools, processes, AI\-enabled practices, and ways of working.

* **Think Differently:** Encourage innovation and apply AI\-enabled and modern engineering approaches to improve outcomes.
* **Open \& Direct Communication:** Build trust and alignment through transparent, constructive, and timely communication.
* **Accelerate Early Wins:** Deliver incremental value early and build momentum toward strategic objectives.

 **What Will Set You Apart (Preferred Qualifications):**

* Experience supporting mining technology, machine applications, fleet management, autonomy, or industrial software solutions.
* Deep product and customer domain expertise gained through ownership of complex software products and solutions.
* Experience leading geographically distributed software and systems engineering teams.
* Demonstrated success driving organizational transformation, engineering excellence, and AI\-enabled productivity improvements.

September 29, 2026 \- October 12, 2026

title: Business Relationship Manager
description:
**Job Description**


**Job Title: Business Relationship Manager**


**Overview:**



The Business Relationship Manager serves as the primary link between the AI team and business units across the organization. The role is responsible for gathering business requirements, prioritizing AI initiatives, supporting technology rollouts, and ensuring successful adoption and business value of AI solutions.



The role will work closely with business stakeholders, engineering teams, and Learning \& Development to drive adoption, track usage and satisfaction, and address adoption risks.


**Roles \& responsibility:**

  


* Own and maintain relationships with business unit stakeholders across the organization, serving as their primary point of contact for AI team engagement.
* Gather business requirements and user needs, translating them into prioritized, well\-scoped inputs for the engineering team.
* Define, track, and report on adoption and usage metrics for deployed AI solutions — not just delivery status.
* Design and execute change communication and rollout plans for phased deployments, partnering with Learning \& Development on training hand\-off.
* Serve as the escalation point for business\-unit feedback and concerns regarding AI tooling and automations.
* Identify early signals of adoption risk and drive corrective action before they surface as broader dissatisfaction.
* Facilitate prioritization discussions, bringing business context and stakeholder impact to bear on engineering roadmap decisions.
* Report adoption outcomes, business value, and stakeholder sentiment to executive leadership.
* Build and maintain a repeatable framework for onboarding new business units onto AI\-enabled workflows.

  


**Qualifications**

  


* Bachelor's degree in business administration, Communications, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3\+ years of experience in business relationship management, stakeholder management, product management, customer success, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience driving adoption of new technology or business processes.
* Experience defining and tracking adoption, usage, or satisfaction metrics.
* Experience gathering business requirements and working with technical/engineering teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities across multiple business units.
* Working knowledge of AI and automation capabilities and limitations.
* Willingness to work in a 24/7 environment


**Preferred skills and experience**


* Experience in financial services, healthcare, or another regulated industry.
* Experience supporting AI, automation, or emerging technology rollouts.
* Experience managing relationships across multiple departments.
* Change management certification such as Prosci ADKAR or CCMP.
* Business analysis certification such as CBAP or PMI\-PBA.
* Product/program management certification such as PMP or CSPO.

title: Customer Engagement Manager
description:
**About Rocketlane**


Rocketlane is a fast\-growing, innovative SaaS company making waves in customer onboarding and professional services automation.


Our mission? To empower B2B companies with a smooth, consistent, and efficient way to onboard customers and manage client projects—reducing chaos and boosting customer satisfaction across industries.


We’re a close\-knit team of over 100 passionate professionals, all focused on building a product that teams love to use. Our journey has been fueled by $45M in funding from top investors, including 8VC, Matrix Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Engagement Manager \- US


**What will you do ?**


* **Customer Engagement \& Relationship Management:**



	+ Act as a strategic advisor, building strong relationships with key stakeholders, executives, and cross\-functional teams.
	+ Drive engagement success by aligning customer goals with Rocketlane’s platform capabilities.
	+ Ensure smooth onboarding and implementation, driving adoption and time\-to\-value.
* **Project \& Program Management:**



	+ Lead and manage multiple customer implementations, ensuring on\-time and within\-budget delivery.
	+ Establish clear project plans, track milestones, and proactively address risks and roadblocks.
	+ Leverage Rocketlane and other PSA tools for project tracking, forecasting, and reporting.
* **Process Optimization \& Change Management:**



	+ Identify and implement best practices to enhance customer onboarding and professional services delivery.
	+ Drive process improvements that improve efficiency, scalability, and customer satisfaction.

* **Strategic \& Analytical Thinking:**



	+ Utilize data\-driven insights to optimize engagement strategies and enhance customer experience.
	+ Work with internal teams to provide feedback, influence product enhancements, and refine service offerings.
* **Customer Success \& Retention:**



	+ Collaborate with Customer Success teams to ensure continued value realization for customers.
	+ Partner with Sales to identify expansion opportunities and contribute to business growth.
**Who We're Looking For:**


* Results\-driven professional with **10\+ years of experience** in project/program management, service delivery, and stakeholder engagement.
* Strong customer\-facing and executive communication skills, with a proven ability to build relationships internally and externally.
* Expertise in organizational and change management, balancing competing client demands while ensuring on\-time, within\-budget delivery.
* Proficient in project financials and PSA tools. Adept at navigating critical business situations with a customer\-centric approach, strong interpersonal skills, and cultural awareness.
* Skilled in professional services metrics within a SaaS environment, with a background in **customer onboarding, implementation, and professional services automation (PSA).** Thrives in fast\-paced, dynamic environments, fostering collaboration and adaptability.

**Why join us?**


At Rocketlane, we’re all about building a great product and a great place to work. Here’s why you’ll actually look forward to Mondays:


* **Impact and ownership**: You won’t just be another cog in the machine; here, you’re more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen.
* **Work with the best**: We’re a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes.
* **Celebrate wins**: Whether we’re hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From rap videos to team outings, we believe in celebrating big.
* **Learn and grow**: We’re all about learning—and we’re not just talking about the latest SaaS trends. You’ll grow your career, pick up new skills, and maybe even learn to love Excel (or at least tolerate it).
* **Flexibility and balance**: While we love collaborating in the office five days a week, we know everyone has their own rhythm. That’s why we offer flexibility around hours—so you can bring your best energy, whether you’re an early bird or a night owl. Pajamas optional (at least outside the office).

title: Technical Account Manager - US TimeZone
description:
### **About the Role**


Rocketlane is looking for a highly motivated **Technical Account Manager (TAM)** to bridge our customers' success with internal excellence. As a TAM, you will combine deep product expertise, technical acumen, and exceptional communication to drive meaningful customer outcomes. You’ll collaborate cross\-functionally to address complex needs, articulate feature requests, and develop tailored solutions for customers while building long\-term partnerships.


You are a trusted advisor with a knack for solving problems and delivering results. Whether it's configuring custom workflows, navigating APIs, or guiding customers through technical challenges, you will help unlock value from Rocketlane’s platform.


### **Responsibilities**


#### **Technical Expertise**


* Master Rocketlane’s product suite to provide unparalleled guidance and support to customers.
* Configure custom workflows and troubleshoot API integrations.
* Diagnose and resolve technical challenges to ensure seamless customer experience.

#### **Customer Engagement**


* Foster strong relationships by acting as the primary technical point of contact for strategic customers.
* Deliver training sessions to empower customers in using Rocketlane effectively.
* Ensure expectations are set and met through transparent communication and actionable insights.

#### **Business Alignment**


* Translate customer needs into actionable feedback for Product, Engineering, and other internal teams.
* Guide customers in aligning Rocketlane’s solutions to their business objectives.
* Provide consulting and prescriptive advice to maximize customer adoption.

#### **Team Collaboration**


* Mentor team members to elevate collective performance.
* Contribute to team morale by leading initiatives that foster process improvements and team collaboration.
* Actively drive feedback loops with Product and Engineering to enhance Rocketlane’s offerings.


#### **Qualifications**


	+ 4\-8 years of relevant experience in TAM or Product Consulting roles.
	+ Expertise in managing high\-profile customer accounts, with a proven track record of delivering exceptional results.
	+ Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities effectively.
	+ Strong solutioning skills with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical problems.
	+ Deep understanding of APIs, migrations, and SaaS platforms.
	+ Demonstrated ability to translate technical jargon into business\-friendly communication.
	+ Excellent written and verbal communication, capable of engaging both technical and non\-technical audiences.
	+ Expertise in rapport building, expectation setting, and managing strategic customer relationships.
	+ Training and presentation skills to effectively communicate solutions and best practices.
	+ Confidence to push back where necessary, balanced by a collaborative approach.
	+ Negotiation skills that drive win\-win outcomes.
	+ A natural mentor who inspires and motivates teams to perform at their best.
	+ Experience driving cross\-functional initiatives and contributing to process improvements.

Job Description:
**Customer Support \& Communication:**

* Manage customer service requests including order status updates, acknowledgment requests, and invoice requests via phone and email.
* Manage a high volume of Supply Chain and internal stakeholder communications
* Collaborate with the appropriate level of customer support to resolve challenging inquiries and complaints, ensuring clear documentation and ongoing communication with the customer throughout the process.
* Serve as the primary or secondary point of contact for customer support needs, ensuring a high level of service and responsiveness.

**Order Management \& Processing:**

* Accurately process orders, including material numbers, quantities, and pricing, while resolving line holds due to pricing discrepancies or missing pricing information.
* Conduct research on part numbers to ensure accurate order processing and resolve product related issues.
* Review open orders for On Time In Full (OTIF) compliance and coordinate with production or supply chain teams to ensure execution.
* Assist sales representatives with order placement, status updates, inventory lookups, and customer related concerns.
* Provide technical support for part search and pricing inquiries.
* Returns, Credits \& Issue Resolution:
* Submit and manage credit and return requests related to concealed damages, shortages, carrier damages, pricing disputes, and other customer reported discrepancies.
* Work with internal stakeholders to minimize and resolve customer deductions without resolution.

 **Systems, Documentation \& Reporting:*** Maintain accurate records of all internal and external interactions in SAP.
* Ensure consistent adherence to department policies, procedures, and documentation standards.
* Maintain oversight of order related data accuracy to support reporting and operational visibility.

**Process Improvement \& Collaboration:*** Propose and support new processes that drive continuous improvement and reduce inefficiencies.
* Identify and communicate areas for process improvement to management.
* Support order management team goals and initiatives to strengthen a proactive customer support model.
* Work cross functionally with Planning, Logistics, Transportation, Brokers/Carriers, Supply Chain, Exports, Accounting, and other departments to ensure customer requirements are met.
* Contribute to the development of a centralized customer service HUB for order tracking and management.

**Additional Responsibilities:*** Perform other duties and tasks as assigned by the manager to support departmental and organizational goals.
* Adapt to evolving job requirements and contribute to special projects or cross functional initiatives as needed.


Qualifications:
* **4 to 6 years of experience** in Order Management or related roles.
* Experience working with SAP
* Any Graduate / bachelor’s degree

title: Lead Key Account Manager Govt
description:
### **Why join Stryker?**


Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award\-winning culture.  

We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.### **Job description**


We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine!
  

We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.  

### **What You Will Do**

* Own and grow Stryker's Government business across **Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and Kerala**, delivering sustainable revenue growth and achieving sales targets.
* Develop and execute strategic account plans for key Government institutions, Medical Colleges, and Group Purchasing Organizations (GPOs).
* Manage the complete **Tender\-to\-Cash lifecycle**, including tender identification, pre\-bid activities, technical and commercial submissions, order management, installation, and payment collection.
* Drive business through **GeM Portal, State E\-Procurement Platforms, Rate Contracts, DME/DHS, and Central Government procurement channels**.
* Build and strengthen relationships with key stakeholders including Deans, Medical Superintendents, HoDs, Biomedical Engineers, Procurement Leaders, and Finance Heads.
* Identify, develop, and convert new business opportunities within Government healthcare institutions to increase market share and account penetration.
* Lead strategic discussions, product presentations, and business reviews with senior Government officials and institutional leadership teams.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams including Sales, Marketing, Service, Clinical, Finance, and Legal to deliver customer\-centric solutions.
* Drive product adoption, solution selling, and customer value creation by understanding institutional needs and aligning Stryker's portfolio accordingly.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for Government Key Accounts, ensuring high customer satisfaction, long\-term partnerships, and business retention.

### **What You Need**

* **5 to 9 years of experience** in Government Institutional Sales, Key Account Management, or Business Development within the Medical Device, MedTech, Healthcare, or Pharma industry.
* Proven success managing Government healthcare accounts across **Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and Kerala**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Government Tenders, GeM, Rate Contracts, DME/DHS, AIIMS, ESIC, Railways, Defence, and other Central/State Government institutions**.
* Strong expertise in strategic account management, stakeholder engagement, negotiation, business planning, and payment collection.
* Bachelor's degree in Science, Pharmacy, Biomedical Engineering, or a related discipline; **MBA preferred**.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior decision\-makers, build long\-term partnerships, and drive growth in complex Government healthcare environments.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Manager, Corporate Strategy
description:
**The Company**


PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.


We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.


We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.


Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.


**Job Summary:**


This job identifies issues and recommends best practices, leading functional projects that drive business improvements. They partner with teams to analyze business trends and facilitate collaboration among team members. This role assesses and reports on the progress of strategic initiatives, contributing to the organization's success.

* Identify issues and recommend best practices based on specialized expertise.
  

  
* Lead functional projects and programs that contribute to business improvements.
  

  
* Partner with teams to analyze business trends and inform strategic decisions.
  

  
* Facilitate collaboration among team members to enhance project outcomes.
  

  
* Assess and report on the progress of strategic initiatives within the function.
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

**Additional Responsibilities \& Preferred Qualifications****:**

PayPal

All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately.
